workflow-orchestrator.description: Coordinates the workflow: frames and plans work, delegates bounded assignments, records receipts and resumes from the records.

workflow-explorer.description: Answers one bounded question with primary evidence and writes a focused research artifact.

workflow-worker.description: Works one task instance at a time: authors a solution design as a design worker, or delivers an approved outcome within owned paths as an implementation worker; returns a compact receipt.

workflow-verifier.description: Independently checks an authored design before it reaches the user, and frozen artifacts against acceptance criteria; returns a verdict.
